nina-sales: Quick heads-up: CrescendoHealth (EU payer) requesting consolidated POC evidence pack. They asked for SOC2 Type II excerpt, ISO 27001 certificate, network/topology diagram, signed pen-test attestation (they said "signed letter preferred"), and a short note on whether Dedicated vs Private affects pricing/timeline. POC kickoff target May 3. Can someone take lead? @anya-security :eyes:

charlie-ae: Quick clarifying q: full SOC2 report or excerpt/control matrix only? Also whether vendor contact redaction is required. And do they need KMS/HSM split details for Private deployment?

anya-security: I can own SOC2 excerpt + ISO cert + network diagram. For the signed attestation we have a standard pen-test letter template that states "no critical or high findings as of [scan date]". Legal sign-off required for signature. Expect ~3 business days once scope is nailed down.

uploader-bot: Upload workspace created: s3://proofpacks/crescendo/1725559999/ 
Presign (48h):
curl -X PUT "https://uploads.redwood/proofpacks/1725559999?sig=abc123" -F file=@evidence.zip
(Do not paste creds in thread) :lock:

devon-infra: We can carve a /28 and hand over 3 static IPs for external scans. If they want Dedicated during the POC the delta is approx +$6k/mo. Private (on-prem/VPC) requires project setup (~$12k one-time) + ~2 week lead. Staging IPs available ~36h after owner assigned.

matt-legal: We can provide a signed pen-test attestation on letterhead. Need recipient name + expected wording (e.g. "no critical findings" vs full summary). Also confirm NDA covers sending signed artifacts. Typical turnaround: draft 1 business day, sign-off 1 more.

nina-sales: Target delivery to customer by Apr 28 so they can complete internal approvals before May 3. @charlie-ae confirm Type II vs Type I with the PO. @anya-security please own the bundle and upload to the s3 path. @devon-infra please reserve the IPs and add IP list to the proofpack manifest.

charlie-ae: Pinged PO. They prefer Type II excerpts and said redaction of internal contacts is fine. Will confirm KMS ask and update by EOD. :thumbsup:

anya-security: Acknowledged. I'll start pulling artifacts once Charlie confirms KMS/scope. I'll post a draft pen-test attestation here for legal review when ready.

matt-legal: Acknowledged. Once draft is posted include recipient email and I'll route for signature.

nina-sales: Thanks all 00 please flag blockers here. :pray:
